outputs.explanation: Body weight, LW/BW, and FW/BW are shown as dot/scatter plots with mean ± SD, with individual animal data points clearly plotted.
Panel B shows representative gross photographs of mice, not a quantitative plot.
Panel C shows representative H&E and Oil Red O micrographs, not a quantitative plot.
Panel D shows a 5mC dot blot and methylene blue staining image (blot type), with no averaged plot presented here (quantification is in panel E).
The 5mC/Methylene Blue quantification is a bar chart with individual data points (dots for NC and HFD) overlaid on the mean ± SD bars.
Panel F contains western blots (TET1/2/3, GAPDH) plus a bottom bar chart quantifying TETs/GAPDH ratio, which shows individual data points (circles/squares) overlaid on the mean ± SEM bars.
